review:
Lucky's Wild Pub is an Irish pub slot where bonus coins can randomly trigger the Pot Respin feature with modifiers. Green coins upgrade up to three money symbols, red coins add an extra 5x3 grid, and blue coins add a respin, and any combination can apply.

In the feature, money symbols worth up to 30x land alongside bonus values of 10x, 20x and 150x, all sticky for the round. Each new money symbol resets the respins, and the round ends when respins run out or the grid fills. Pragmatic Play's page and the game's intro quote different maximums, so we haven't listed one. The RTP is 96.5%.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
